requirements: Is there exactly one single figure of Rose shown?
Is the figure shown in a full body pose from the top of the head to the shoes?
Is the figure standing and alone?
Is the figure facing the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle turned toward the left?
Are the eyes directed toward the left as if listening to someone off-screen?
Is the head tipped slightly forward?
Are both hands loosely clasped in front at the waist?
Is the mouth closed in a small attentive smile?
Are the eyebrows a little raised?
Does the figure fill about 85 percent of the picture height and appear centered?
